title: DeXposure-Claw：用于DeFi风险监管的智能代理系统
summary: DeXposure-Claw 是一个基于预测的代理监管系统，通过结构化证据引导LLM决策，包括图时间序列基础模型、确定性监控和压力场景、数据健康与置信度门控，并开发了六轴评估基准DeXposure-Bench，在真实数据上验证了有效性。
summary_en: DeXposure-Claw is a forecast-grounded agentic supervision system that routes LLM decisions through structured evidence, including a graph time-series foundation model, deterministic monitors and stress scenarios, data-health and confidence gates, and a six-axis evaluation benchmark DeXposure-Bench, validated on real data.
